method.cost_model: 15 bps per unit of absolute exposure turnover, charged on each daily rebalance
method.selection: Highest net training Sharpe in each 1095-day training window; applied only to following 182-day test fold
method.no_lookahead: Signals use only historical closes; execution uses next-day return
method.win_rate_definition: Profitable uninterrupted long-exposure cycles divided by all observed long-exposure cycles; not per-order win rate

limitations: CSV data is stale; latest row is 2026-05-23 and cannot support a current-market signal.
Close-only data; Quattro 4H perpetual backtest cannot be run from these files.
Funding, liquidation, market impact and venue-specific fills are not modeled.
